persona: Female, 25-35, warm and confident; Arabic MSA, English neutral American
tashkeel_rule: Arabic text sent to TTS carries full tashkeel on EVERY word, on every letter that takes a mark and on case endings (إعراب), no exceptions, proofread with arabic-english-proofreading before voicing; visible text never does. The manifest carries it as tts_text and voice_style_gate.py enforces it.
direction_rule: Direction is a natural-language English prefix to the input text, used for both languages; Gemini does not speak it (read-back checked).

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, with more energy and a lively, upbeat pace, like a friendly expert sharing exciting news:
styles.sample_en: Meet Acme. We build artificial intelligence and robotics that work in the real world. Follow along as we build.
styles.sample_ar: تعرفوا على أكمي. نبني ذكاء اصطناعيا وروبوتات تعمل في العالم الحقيقي. تابعونا ونحن نبني.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: تَعَرَّفُوا عَلَى أَكْمِي. نَبْنِي ذَكَاءً اصْطِنَاعِيًّا وَرُوبُوتَاتٍ تَعْمَلُ فِي الْعَالَمِ الْحَقِيقِيِّ. تَابِعُونَا وَنَحْنُ نَبْنِي.
styles.good_for: Social reels, short promos, teasers, launch clips under about 60 s.
styles.never_for: Safety notices, legal or regulatory statements, step-by-step manuals (energy reads as hype and rushes the listener).

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
styles.sample_en: Welcome to Acme. In this guide, you will learn each step in order. Take your time, and pause whenever you need.
styles.sample_ar: مرحبا بكم في أكمي. في هذا الدليل ستتعلمون كل خطوة بالترتيب. خذوا وقتكم، وتوقفوا متى شئتم.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ فِي أَكْمِي. فِي هَذَا الدَّلِيلِ سَتَتَعَلَّمُونَ كُلَّ خُطْوَةٍ بِالتَّرْتِيبِ. خُذُوا وَقْتَكُمْ، وَتَوَقَّفُوا مَتَى شِئْتُمْ.
styles.good_for: User manuals, tutorials, e-learning explainers, onboarding walkthroughs and narrated product demos (this style also covers explainer, demo and welcome use).
styles.never_for: Announcements, ads, anything urgent: the unhurried pace makes urgency sound careless.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently, composed and measured, with a formal professional tone:
styles.sample_en: Acme is a technology company working in artificial intelligence and robotics. This statement is issued on behalf of the company.
styles.sample_ar: أكمي شركة تقنية تعمل في الذكاء الاصطناعي والروبوتات. صدر هذا البيان باسم الشركة.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: أَكْمِي شَرِكَةٌ تِقْنِيَّةٌ تَعْمَلُ فِي الذَّكَاءِ الِاصْطِنَاعِيِّ وَالرُّوبُوتَاتِ. صَدَرَ هَذَا الْبَيَانُ بِاسْمِ الشَّرِكَةِ.
styles.good_for: Company statements, press and ministry-facing text, announcements and news items, formal introductions, investor or grant material.
styles.never_for: Reels, stories, casual chat: the formal register sounds cold where warmth is needed.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently, with more emotion and feeling, like a storyteller who cares about the story:
styles.sample_en: It started with a simple question: what if a machine could truly help? That question became Acme.
styles.sample_ar: بدأت القصة بسؤال بسيط: ماذا لو استطاعت الآلة أن تساعد حقا؟ وصار هذا السؤال أكمي.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: بَدَأَتِ الْقِصَّةُ بِسُؤَالٍ بَسِيطٍ: مَاذَا لَوِ اسْتَطَاعَتِ الْآلَةُ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَ حَقًّا؟ وَصَارَ هَذَا السُّؤَالُ أَكْمِي.
styles.good_for: Brand story, founder or mission narration, testimonials told as narrative, keynote or inspirational openings, about-us films.
styles.never_for: Instructions, data, warnings: emotion gets in the way of the information.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently but firm and serious, clear and deliberate, like a caring safety officer who needs you to listen:
styles.sample_en: Warning. Keep clear of the Acme robot while it is moving. Stop the machine before you reach in.
styles.sample_ar: تحذير. ابتعدوا عن روبوت أكمي أثناء حركته. أوقفوا الآلة قبل أن تدخلوا أيديكم فيها.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: تَحْذِيرٌ. اِبْتَعِدُوا عَنْ رُوبُوتِ أَكْمِي أَثْنَاءَ حَرَكَتِهِ. أَوْقِفُوا الْآلَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْخِلُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ فِيهَا.
styles.good_for: Robot and workplace safety notices, warnings, error and failure messages in a product, critical reminders where the listener must act.
styles.never_for: Marketing, welcome, storytelling; and gentle recoverable product errors ("something went wrong, try again"), which belong to chat: a firm tone turns a friendly message into a scolding.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently, but crisp and matter-of-fact, brisker than usual, with a short beat before each number and a clear stress on the figures, no emotional colouring, like an analyst reading out results:
styles.sample_en: In the last quarter, the Acme system processed twelve thousand requests. Ninety-eight percent finished with no errors.
styles.sample_ar: عالج نظام أكمي في الربع الأخير اثني عشر ألف طلب. واكتمل ثمانية وتسعون في المائة منها دون أخطاء.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: عَالَجَ نِظَامُ أَكْمِي فِي الرُّبْعِ الْأَخِيرِ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ أَلْفَ طَلَبٍ. وَاكْتَمَلَ ثَمَانِيَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ فِي الْمِائَةِ مِنْهَا دُونَ أَخْطَاءٍ.
styles.good_for: Statistics and results readouts, QA and test-report summaries, dashboard and quarterly-figures narration, benchmark results.
styles.never_for: Reels, stories, invitations: the level, even delivery flattens anything meant to move people.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently, in a soft, personal, intimate tone, a little slower than a promo, with a gentle rising lift on the final invitation, like a host quietly inviting a friend to join:
styles.sample_en: Join us at the Acme open day. Come meet the team, see the robots at work, and bring your questions.
styles.sample_ar: انضموا إلينا في يوم أكمي المفتوح. تعالوا وتعرفوا على الفريق، وشاهدوا الروبوتات وهي تعمل، وأحضروا أسئلتكم.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: اِنْضَمُّوا إِلَيْنَا فِي يَوْمِ أَكْمِي الْمَفْتُوحِ. تَعَالَوْا وَتَعَرَّفُوا عَلَى الْفَرِيقِ، وَشَاهِدُوا الرُّوبُوتَاتِ وَهِيَ تَعْمَلُ، وَأَحْضِرُوا أَسْئِلَتَكُمْ.
styles.good_for: Event and open-day invitations, programme and webinar calls to join, call-to-action closes at the end of a film or post.
styles.never_for: Warnings, official statements, data: the bright, personal address sounds out of place.

styles.direction: Say this warmly and confidently, in a relaxed, natural, conversational way, like talking to a colleague over coffee:
styles.sample_en: Good question. Honestly, it is simpler than it sounds. Acme learns from what you show it, and it gets better every time.
styles.sample_ar: سؤال جيد. بصراحة، الأمر أبسط مما يبدو. أكمي تتعلم مما تريها إياه، وتتحسن في كل مرة.
styles.sample_ar_tashkeel: سُؤَالٌ جَيِّدٌ. بِصَرَاحَةٍ، الْأَمْرُ أَبْسَطُ مِمَّا يَبْدُو. أَكْمِي تَتَعَلَّمُ مِمَّا تُرِيهَا إِيَّاهُ، وَتَتَحَسَّنُ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ.
styles.good_for: Assistant and chatbot voice, FAQ answers, podcast-style asides, customer-support replies, informal Q and A, short testimonial-style quotes. Also gentle recoverable errors and soft apologies.
styles.never_for: Official statements, warnings, long narration: the casual register undermines authority and drifts over length.

rejected: Same calm, step-by-step, clear delivery as Manual; a second id would produce the same audio.
Manual's pace with Reel's warmth; both exist, so the choice is per video, not a new tone.
Manual's own sample line is a welcome; no distinct delivery.
Needs composed authority (Official) or lift (Reel); a third tone between them cannot be told apart in direction wording.
Story's emotional storyteller direction covers it; a louder version drifts into Reel energy.
Folded into Chat (first-person quote) and Story (narrative); no separate delivery.
Merged with event invitation into Invite: same bright personal address.

No Acme or QA piece needs it that the 8 do not cover: multi-minute manuals are already narrated in manual style, and an 8-second sample cannot show sustained delivery over 2 minutes, which is the only claim such a style would make. Revisit when a real long piece exists.
Folded into chat good_for (soft errors and apologies); no separate delivery.

pace_target_wpm.method: words of the visible text / finished clip seconds x 60; per-clip atempo = target / raw wpm after the silence trim.

loudness.source: a single final master pass; reused as is.

control.en: Acme builds robots that help people. The first one is ready, and it can already pick up a cup.
control.ar: تبني أكمي روبوتات تساعد الناس. الأول جاهز، وهو يستطيع الآن أن يلتقط كوبا.
control.ar_tashkeel: تَبْنِي أَكْمِي رُوبُوتَاتٍ تُسَاعِدُ النَّاسَ. الْأَوَّلُ جَاهِزٌ، وَهُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ الْآنَ أَنْ يَلْتَقِطَ كُوبًا.
control.note: Same text through every style, ar and en, so styles compare on equal text.
